QuestInfo.parent: A Task for a Citizen of Honor
QuestInfo.name: The Weight of Truth
QuestInfo.1: #p436# at #m10003098# succeeded in deciphering #t4031132# using #t4031133#. But the look on #p436#'s face darkened as he read over the deciphered document... Anyway, I'd better bring this to #b#p411##k at #m10003000# right away.  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I brought #b#t4031135##k to #b#p411##k at #m10003000#. Upon seeing the document, he fell silent for a long moment, having confirmed that Rex, once his comrade and friend, had sacrificed himself for his sake back then... Afterward, he told me I'd carried out the task admirably and handed me a gift. I think every time I look at this #t1032022#, I'll be reminded of #p411# and his friend.

0.0: Alright, shall we get to work, then? Sprinkling this #t4031133# onto the #t4031132#, little by little... hup... hm? This needs more precision than it looks, so give me a moment.

yes.0: Alright. Finally done. Trickier than it looked, but nothing a bit of care and patience couldn't handle. Huh... wait, this is... hmph... I see... it's nothing. Anyway, go on and take #b#t4031135##k to #b#p411##k. And I'd appreciate it if you kept quiet about me being out here, even after this. That's all from me.

1.0: You're back. This #t4031135#... heh heh. Guess #p436# hasn't lost his touch after all. Let me have a look, then. ... This is...
1.1: Damn it... Rex, you idiot... I told him to get out safely, no matter what, if he was ever discovered... but he ended up standing his ground against them alone, and in the end... he fell. All for our sake...
1.2: The truth is, Rex was never kidnapped. When things started going worse than we'd expected, he volunteered himself as a spy, disguised himself, deliberately approached them, and infiltrated their hideout. He'd judged that hitting them there could turn the whole situation around.
1.3: But then they saw through his disguise, and it seems he took them on alone, doing as much damage as he could... before he finally fell. And I'd told him, again and again, to pull out the second things got dangerous. Foolish man...
1.4: ...But it seems his sacrifice wasn't for nothing. Come to think of it, I always wondered why they'd risked exposing themselves for such a reckless attack... it was because of the damage Rex had dealt to their base, on top of the growing attention on all those disappearances and kidnappings in this city hitting the news. They must've gotten desperate.
1.5: Heh heh... it's been a while since I've told an old story at such length. Thanks to you, I finally know what happened to Rex back then. I'm grateful to you for that. Now then, I suppose it's time I gave you the gift I promised. Here, take this #b#t1032022##k.
1.6: Consider it a reward for everything you've done for this city, and for carrying out this task so well. And I'll trust you'll keep standing with us going forward. Take care, then.

item.0: You're back. Are you saying #p436# managed to decipher it? So then, where's the #t4031135#?

npc.0: Not much patience, have you? Take this #b#t4031135##k to #b#p411##k at #b#m10003000##k. The truth can be a hard thing to swallow, sometimes.

lost.0: Don't tell me you lost #b#t4031135##k. Heh... you'd best hold onto it more carefully this time.
